title: Turn on Light Mode on iPhone
prerequisites: Mirror your iPhone into Hodey (menu → Show iPhone) and start on the Home Screen, in Dark mode.
concept: Light Mode shows dark text on a light background, which is clearest in daylight.
recap: You turned on Light Mode: Settings, Display & Brightness, then Light.

check.question: Quick check: where do you switch between Light and Dark?
check.explain: Display & Brightness controls how the screen looks.

speech.demonstrate: On your iPhone, tap Settings, the grey gear. I've highlighted it.
speech.hint: Which app holds all of your phone's options?

steps.explain: Settings holds every iPhone option, including how the screen looks.

speech.demonstrate: Scroll down a little and tap Display & Brightness.
speech.hint: Look for the setting about your screen.

steps.explain: Display & Brightness controls light and dark appearance, text size and brightness.

mistakes.correction: That's Wallpaper. Tap Settings at the top left to go back, then choose Display & Brightness.

speech.demonstrate: Under Appearance, tap Light. The whole screen will turn bright.
speech.hint: Appearance has two choices. Which one is brighter?

steps.explain: Light Mode uses dark text on light backgrounds, which is clearest in bright light.

mistakes.correction: That opened Text Size. Go back; Light is under Appearance at the top.
